# 蓮邦詩選

**ID:** X1207
**Volume:** X62
**Category:** 淨土宗部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗著述部／淨土宗
**Byline:** 明 廣貴輯
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1207

## Contributors
- 廣貴 (A001665)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juǎn* anthology of Pure Land devotional verse — *zàn* 讚, *jié* 偈, *sòng* 頌, and *shī* 詩 — compiled by the late-Míng Pure Land monk [廣貴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E8%B2%B4) **Yùfēng Guǎngguì** 玉峰廣貴 in the late Wànlì or early Tiānqǐ period. The title — *liánbāng* 蓮邦 ("Lotus Land") — is a standard Pure Land idiom for Sukhāvatī, the realm imagined as a paradisal lotus garden in Amitābha's western Pure Land.

**Abstract**

The anthology gathers Pure Land devotional verse from across the Chinese tradition, organised by author and roughly chronologically: the foundational *zàn* of [曇鸞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E9%B8%9E) **Tánluán** (the *Zàn ēmítuó fó jié* [KR6p0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0073)) and [善導](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E5%B0%8E) **Shàndǎo** (the canonical *zàn* sequences [KR6p0074](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0074) [KR6p0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0075) [KR6p0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0076)); the Sòng-period devotional verse of the Tiāntái Pure Land lineage ([知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Sìmíng Zhīlǐ, [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) Cíyún Zūnshì); the Yuán-period White Lotus / Liánzōng verse ([普度](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E5%BA%A6) Yōután Pǔdù, [天如則](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A9%E5%A6%82%E5%89%87) Tiānrú Wéizé); and the late-Míng literati Pure Land poetry ([袁宏道](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%81%E5%AE%8F%E9%81%93) Yuán Hóngdào, [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng, and lesser figures of the Yúnqī circle).

The work serves a **devotional-liturgical** function rather than a purely literary one: the verse selections are organised for daily recitation and chant, with prosodic conventions (mostly five- and seven-syllable lines, regular tonal patterns) that make them suited to the rhythms of monastic *kèsòng* 課誦 (recitation services) and lay-Buddhist devotional gatherings. The anthology can be read alongside the canonical Pure Land *zàn* texts (T1978–T1984, [KR6p0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0073)–[KR6p0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0079)) as a thematically related liturgical corpus.

The text is preserved only in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏 (X1207). No preface fixes a precise composition date; the dating bracket adopted (1590–1640) covers the late Wànlì / Tiānqǐ / Chóngzhēn period during which Guǎngguì was active.
